questiontext.text:
The storage shed shown below consists of a rectangular prism and a triangular prism roof. Calculate the total volume of the shed.

Give your answer in m\(^3\).

[[jsxgraph]] var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard('jxgbox',{ boundingbox:[-50,450,850,-50], keepAspectRatio:true, axis:false, showCopyright:false }); /* Front face */ var A = board.create('point',[120,80],{visible:false}); var B = board.create('point',[360,80],{visible:false}); var C = board.create('point',[360,200],{visible:false}); var D = board.create('point',[120,200],{visible:false}); /* Roof apex front */ var R1 = board.create('point',[240,280],{visible:false}); /* Back face offset */ var dx = 220; var dy = 90; var E = board.create('point',[120+dx,80+dy],{visible:false}); var F = board.create('point',[360+dx,80+dy],{visible:false}); var G = board.create('point',[360+dx,200+dy],{visible:false}); var H = board.create('point',[120+dx,200+dy],{visible:false}); /* Roof apex back */ var R2 = board.create('point',[240+dx,280+dy],{visible:false}); /* Front rectangle */ board.create('segment',[A,B]); board.create('segment',[B,C]); board.create('segment',[C,D]); board.create('segment',[D,A]); /* Back rectangle */ board.create('segment',[E,F]); board.create('segment',[F,G]); board.create('segment',[G,H]); board.create('segment',[H,E]); /* Connect front and back */ board.create('segment',[A,E]); board.create('segment',[B,F]); board.create('segment',[C,G]); board.create('segment',[D,H]); /* Front roof */ board.create('segment',[D,R1]); board.create('segment',[R1,C]); /* Back roof */ board.create('segment',[H,R2]); board.create('segment',[R2,G]); /* Roof ridge */ board.create('segment',[R1,R2]); /* Roof side connections */ board.create('segment',[D,H]); board.create('segment',[C,G]); /* Dimension labels */ /* Length */ board.create('text',[ 420, 120, '{#L#} m' ]); /* Width */ board.create('text',[ 200, 305, '{#w#} m' ]); /* Wall height */ board.create('text',[ 70, 140, '{#h_wall#} m' ]); /* Roof height */ board.create('text',[ 250, 235, '{#h_roof#} m' ]); [[/jsxgraph]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked solution

The shed is made up of two separate solids:

  • A rectangular prism (the main body of the shed)
  • A triangular prism (the roof)

To find the total volume, calculate the volume of each part separately and then add them together.

Calculate the volume of the rectangular prism

The volume of a rectangular prism is:

\(V=l\times w\times h\)

Substituting the dimensions:

\(V_{\text{rect}}=({@L@})\times({@w@})\times({@h_wall@})\) \(V_{\text{rect}}={@V_rect@}\text{ m}^3\)

Now calculate the volume of the triangular prism roof

First find the area of the triangular cross-section:

\(A=\frac{1}{2}\times(b)\times(h)\) \(A={@cross_section_area@}\text{ m}^2\)

Now multiply this area by the length of the shed:

\(V_{\text{roof}}=({@cross_section_area@})\times({@L@})\) \(V_{\text{roof}}={@V_roof@}\text{ m}^3\)

Proceed to calculate the total volume

\(V_{\text{total}}=V_{\text{rect}}+V_{\text{roof}}\) \(V_{\text{total}}=({@V_rect@})+({@V_roof@})\) \(V_{\text{total}}={@ta@}\text{ m}^3\)

Therefore, the volume of the shed is:

\(\boxed{{@ta@}\text{ m}^3}\)
